key_findings: Descending GABAergic SeIN128 neurons in the Drosophila larval SEZ are excited by Basin and A00c neurons and feed back to inhibit Basins, terminating nociceptive rolling and promoting escape crawling.
Knocking down VGAT in SeIN128 or GABA-A/GABA-B receptors in Basins increased rolling probability and duration.
